name: Kids' table
setupLines: A guest in a red suit is handing out presents. The beard is slipping.
Gene is explaining heredity with crayons. Nobody asked.
"Grown-ups have their own table," says Kindergarten, to Puny, who is grown up.

kindergarten: Kindergarten has worked something out about names. Ask her.
Ask Kindergarten. She runs this table, and she'll remind you.
Kindergarten keeps looking at the beard.
kriss-kringle: Ask the man in the suit. He's expecting you.
Kriss Kringle wants to clear his name. Let him.
Ask Kriss Kringle what's under the beard.
gene: Gene has the dates. Gene always has the dates.
Ask Gene. He'll make a chart.
Gene says he can prove who's related to whom. He's very young.
wunderkind: Wunderkind looked him up. Of course Wunderkind looked him up.
Wunderkind isn't impressed by the suit. Ask why.
